title: Web: TypeScript ID list formatter + data-layer hook
description: Implements kbs-c118a7. Shared TS formatter (default 4, lowercase, widen colliding groups iteratively, no cap) replacing packages/ui format-issue-id.ts (delete it; TaskDetailPanel/StatusTree route through the new hook). Hook at data layer re-runs on visible-set changes (filters, search, columns, trees). Reads short_id_length from snapshot config.
